vibe.description: A bold lower-third title card that slides in from the left: 'Meeting notes → summary in 2 minutes', with a thin accent line
A glowing arrow that swoops in and points at the terminal output, with a small 'it works!' label that pops in
A glossy 3D golden trophy spinning slowly in the top-right corner, with small sparkles orbiting it

component.name: Lower-third title card
component.description: A bold title card slides in from the left with a dark panel and a thin accent line growing beneath the text

component.name: Glowing swooping arrow
component.description: A glowing arrow swoops in along a curved path, points at the center of the box, then bobs gently with a pulsing glow.

component.name: 文字標籤
component.description: 在框的上下左右彈出一個小對話框，尖角指向框

component.name: Golden Trophy Sparkles
component.description: A glossy golden trophy built from lathe, torus and cylinder geometry spins and bobs in the top-right corner while small sparkles orbit and twinkle around it.

component.name: 螢光筆劃記
component.description: 半透明的螢光筆由左到右劃過框裡的字，邊緣略帶手繪感

component.name: 圈選
component.description: 像用筆隨手圈起來的橢圓，筆畫略有起伏、結尾稍微超過起點

component.name: 啵
component.description: 短促的啵一聲：音高快速往下掉，加一點點擊感

component.name: 打勾
component.description: 在框的中央畫出一個勾，可帶外圈

component.name: 成功
component.description: 三個音往上的和弦琶音，表示完成或答對

component.name: 粒子迸發
component.description: 從框的中心迸出一圈彩色紙片，往外飛散、受重力落下並淡出，用在完成或慶祝的時刻

component.name: 閃亮
component.description: 一串細碎的高音，像星星閃一下

component.name: Screen in a scene
component.description: The video plays on a screen in a 3D scene (desk, classroom board or studio); starts and ends full-frame so it cuts in seamlessly

component.name: Floating board
component.description: The video becomes a board that turns, pushes in and pulls back in space; starts and ends full-frame

edges.label: Return to full frame at both ends

backgroundImage.label: Background image (when Background is AI image)

component.name: Mascot
component.description: A little 3D character walks in, stops next to the target box and waves or points at it

component.name: Flip intro
component.description: Cover images flip past faster and faster, a flash, then the title punches in

synths.label: Light, upbeat lo-fi tech background for a coding tutorial, soft drums, warm keys, unobtrusive under speech
synths.prompt: Light, upbeat lo-fi tech background for a coding tutorial, soft drums, warm keys, unobtrusive under speech
